# Generated test data

Run `make generate-test-pcaps`. Scenarios A–G and the DDoS scenarios `DDOS_SYN`,
`DDOS_UDP`, `DDOS_REFLECTION`, `DDOS_ICMP`, `DDOS_OUTBOUND`, `DDOS_MULTI`,
`DDOS_NORMAL`, and `DDOS_SHORT` each produce a `.pcap` and JSON oracle here.
Files are deterministic for seed `20260720` and are intentionally not committed
to keep the repository small.
